title: C++ Warning: Possible Dangling Pointer in modules/gdscript/gdscript.h
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: master (commit 8105ff7ac7), 4.6-dev5, 4.5.1-stable, NOT 4.1.1-stable (however other, less concerning warnings pop up with that one)

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono unknown - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 25 Nov 2025 01:13:51 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (radeonsi, navi22, LLVM 21.1.5, DRM 3.64, 6.17.9-2-cachyos) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.24 GiB memory

### Issue description

Whenever I choose to compile a version >=4.5 with the option optimize=speed, I get the following error:
```
Compiling modules/gdscript/language_server/gdscript_workspace.cpp ...
In file included from modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:31:
In member function 'void GDScriptLanguage::enter_function(CallLevel*, GDScriptInstance*, GDScriptFunction*, Variant*, int*, int*)',
    inlined from 'Variant GDScriptFunction::call(GDScriptInstance*, const Variant**, int, Callable::CallError&, CallState*)' at modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:660:51:
modules/gdscript/gdscript.h:511:29: warning: storing the address of local variable 'call_level' in 'GDScriptLanguage::_call_stack' [-Wdangling-pointer=]
  511 |                 _call_stack = call_level;
      |                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~
modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp: In member function 'Variant GDScriptFunction::call(GDScriptInstance*, const Variant**, int, Callable::CallError&, CallState*)':
modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:659:37: note: 'call_level' declared here
  659 |         GDScriptLanguage::CallLevel call_level;
      |                                     ^~~~~~~~~~
modules/gdscript/gdscript.h:447:40: note: 'GDScriptLanguage::_call_stack' declared here
  447 |         static thread_local CallLevel *_call_stack;
      |                                        ^~~~~~~~~~~
Compiling thirdparty/glslang/glslang/GenericCodeGen/CodeGen.cpp ...
```

I believe this to be more of an "uhm, actually, it should be like this" error, but from a quick google search it seems it could be more impactful than that, though the devs are more likely to know whether it's a real issue more than me. I only caught it because I had dev_mode=yes set and it exited on the warning, and I had it on because I was trying to build bleeding edge. 

Also, I would have researched it more than just googling it, but the surrounding code is pretty unfamiliar to me due to my background being in python and bash.

### Steps to reproduce

1. download the tar.gz for 4.6-dev5 or clone the github master branch as of 12/03/2025 (Dec. 3rd 2025)
2. unzip with tar -xf
3. run scons optimize=speed > log.txt
4. View the only remaining bit of text, the warning/error by itself

N/A
